rules.name: Formal linking word
rules.message: This linking word can read as AI (strict mode).
rules.why: Words like "additionally", "ultimately" and "notably" are normal, but AI writing uses them far more than people do. Strict house styles ask for plainer links.
rules.fix: Try "also", "so", "in the end", or just drop the word.

pass: In the end, the choice is yours.

rules.name: Stiff old-fashioned word
rules.message: This stiff word can read as AI (strict mode).
rules.why: Old-fashioned words like "amongst" and "shall" make writing sound formal. AI writing uses them to sound official.

rules.name: Big adjective
rules.message: This big adjective can read as AI (strict mode).
rules.why: Words like "crucial", "vibrant" and "robust" have real uses, but AI writing adds them everywhere to make things sound important.
rules.fix: Pick a plainer word, or show the size with a number or an example.

pass: We built a system that has not failed in a year.

rules.name: Fancy verb
rules.message: This verb can read as AI (strict mode).
rules.why: Verbs like "leverage", "unpack" and "navigate" sound polished, but AI writing uses them for ordinary actions.

rules.name: Stock AI word
rules.message: This word can read as AI (strict mode).
rules.why: These words are fine on their own, but they turn up in AI writing so often that strict house styles avoid them.

flag: We are thrilled to announce our launch.
The pursuit of growth drives us.
pass: We are glad to announce our launch.

rules.name: Softener or intensifier
rules.message: This softener or intensifier can read as AI (strict mode).
rules.why: Words like "really", "truly" and "honestly" add emphasis without adding meaning. AI writing stacks them up; strict styles cut most of them.
rules.fix: Delete the word and read the sentence again. It is usually stronger.

flag: It is simply the best choice.

rules.name: "In order to"
rules.message: "In order to" can read as AI (strict mode).
rules.why: In almost every sentence, "in order to" means the same as "to". AI writing uses the longer form a lot.

flag: We met in order to plan the trip.
pass: We met to plan the trip.

rules.name: "So," to open a paragraph
rules.message: Opening a paragraph with "So," can read as AI (strict mode).
rules.why: Chatty AI writing often starts a paragraph with "So," to sound casual. It is a habit more than a link.

flag: So, what does this mean for you?

We tested it.

So, here is what we found.
pass: It rained, so we stayed in.
We tested it. So we know.
